47-file handbook · encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Enter the passphrase to unlock.

Heads up: this copy was built with a short, guessable passphrase. It hides the text from casual readers; anyone with the file could crack it offline.

On a phone, turn off auto-capitalisation if the phrase refuses to work — autocorrect is the usual culprit.

How this protects you: the file you are looking at contains only ciphertext. Without the passphrase nobody can read the handbook, and search engines are told not to index it. How it does not protect you: anyone who can reach the URL can still download the encrypted blob, and anyone who has the passphrase can read, copy and re-share everything inside it. Treat the phrase as the secret, not the file.
